featured_reviews.name: Tushar Dev
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst PG experience in Santacruz. Completely irresponsible management.

I stayed at this PG operating under the name PJ Housing / His Stay Her Stay for around 6 months, and it has been a mentally exhausting experience.

Despite collecting electricity charges on time, the management failed to pay the bill to Adani Electricity, which resulted in power cuts on THREE separate occasions. This shows sheer negligence and misuse of money collected from tenants.

There is no proper RO drinking water, frequent basic facility issues, and when problems occur, the owner/management does not answer calls or respond. As working professionals new to Mumbai, this kind of treatment is extremely stressful.

To make things worse, we were suddenly asked to vacate one PG and shifted to another run by the same people, without proper notice or explanation. No professionalism, no accountability, no concern for tenants.

Even after paying rent, deposit, and all charges on time, tenants are treated unfairly and basic necessities are not ensured.

⚠️ Strongly NOT recommended.
If you value peace of mind, stable electricity, and basic human decency, avoid this PG at all costs.
